user.title: Dobby room scheduler
user.description: Creates a local room queue and dashboard controls. Automatic cleaning starts disabled. Configure the vacuum, labels and verified room mappings in the bundled card. No additional cloud account is used.

abort.already_configured: Dobby Scheduler is already configured. Open its dashboard card to change settings.

needs_attention.title: {name} needs you
needs_attention.description:
Dobby stopped with: **{fault}**

It could not clear this by itself, usually because the robot is not back on the dock or still reports an error. Check the robot and dock, then press **Retry** on the Dobby Scheduler card (or the Retry button on the phone notification). This message disappears once the fault clears.
